content: Brazilian MEI/Simples Nacional finance apps: Qipu (DAS generation, boleto, receipts), MaisMei (NF emission, DAS payment), Gestão MEI (cash flow, sales, DAS), Balancinho (free plan, cash flow, AP/AR, reports), App MEI oficial (débito automático DAS, DAS consolidado). None of these apps combine personal household budget with Simples Nacional business tracking in one tool. Pro-labore is a standard accounting concept (owner salary from PJ to PF) but no consumer app models the explicit Casa↔Empresa separation with pró-labore as the only bridge. DAS vence dia 20 todo mês - standard knowledge.
